scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 62 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-zurich-bellinz.story: From Zürich it runs 567 km to Bellinzona; allow about 8 h 18 of riding. The stops in between: Rhine Falls, St Gallen, Appenzell and Davos. The highest point is about 2,500 m. Fluela Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Seosan Getbol → Changdeokgung Palace Complex
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 48 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-mausoleum-of-king-wang-kon-hwaseo.story: 351 km from Kaesŏng to Kaesŏng, about 6 h 03 of riding.
